settings.challenge: Dispersed and shift-based operations must account for different sector rules, fitness-for-work expectations and practical site conditions.

settings.heading:
HLTPAT010 Collect Specimens for
Drugs of Abuse Testing
settings.desc: Develop the practical skills and knowledge required to collect specimens for drugs-of-abuse testing in the workplace.

settings.heading: What's the difference between HLTPAT010 and operator training?
settings.text: HLTPAT010 is nationally recognised training for collecting specimens for drugs-of-abuse testing. Operator training focuses on using and maintaining a specific Andatech device and provides an Andatech certificate of competency.

settings.heading: Do I need both types of training?
settings.text: It depends on the person's role. A specimen collector may need HLTPAT010, while a staff member who only operates a particular device may need device-specific training. Our team can help match the course to each role.

settings.heading: Is the policy consultation free?
settings.text: Yes. The initial policy consultation is complimentary and helps identify the next practical steps for your workplace.

settings.heading: Can Andatech support training across multiple sites?
settings.text: Multi-site delivery requirements can be discussed with our training team. Available formats and scheduling are confirmed during the enquiry process.

settings.heading: What if we need a complete workplace compliance program?
settings.text: Explore Managed Compliance Programs if you need training, equipment, procedures, reporting and ongoing support brought together under one program.
